author: B2zce
quote: Grand Theft Auto VI is honestly one of the biggest disappointments in modern gaming. After waiting over a decade, the final product feels surprisingly shallow and repetitive. The open world of Leonida looks visually impressive on the surface, yet it lacks meaningful interactivity, with most buildings remaining completely inaccessible. Furthermore, the mission design relies heavily on outdated, linear hand-holding that punishes any creative freedom. Combined with sluggish character movement, clunky vehicle handling, and an uninspired story that fails to capture past magic, the game leaves players with a hollow experience.
